findings.why: Viteria Lanzo has no entry in the supplier master and no qualification record. Its standing and any open issues are unknown. Owner: supplier quality manager (L. Bianchi) / purchasing.

sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers HB-620 for PLT-PIN and CUST-NOR. The only current approval is SUP-H (APR-011), because SUP-D's approval was revoked by APR-010. Viteria Lanzo has no approval for this part, site and customer.

sources.quote: A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y, whose customer is Nordhavn. A new casting source is a change of source, so written Nordhavn approval (PPAP) is needed before the first shipment. No document in force covers it.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: There is no 3.1 certificate for MAT-ALSI9CU3 from Viteria Lanzo. Owner: supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo).
